about: Archive only: a decommissioned patch written on llama.cpp master 5193ef1d (an AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 machine). No series.

archived.name: iq1m-mmq
archived.written_on: llama.cpp master 5193ef1d (b12367-5); it applies there (git apply --check, 2026-11-15), not on b12359 / v1.0.0
archived.why: MMQ for IQ1_M in the Q3_K layout (stock MMQ has IQ1_S only; IQ1_M expert matrices fell back to dequantize + hipBLAS past 8 tokens). No switch: always on once applied. Correct on gfx1201: test-backend-ops MUL_MAT 49/49, MUL_MAT_ID 4/4 for iq1_m against the CPU. Speed on a model never measured. Decommissioned 2026-11-14: it does not apply to the pin b12359 (v1.0.0); it can be restored and rebased on an AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 machine if a model needs it.
archived.evidence: BoltBeam git 88cbc557 (added, message holds the test counts), 81cc9688 (removed again after a merge brought it back); BoltBeam tools/patches/README.md (Decommissioned), docs/release-0325-20261114.md
